description: UCI row 10 (age 25, HIGH vulnerability, basic knowledge, RT 5) — sector equity etf: hard fails ['R5'] -> UNSUITABLE
client_narrative: Abiola Okonkwo is 25 years old. Their gross annual income is approximately 17,500 euros (around 1,458 euros per month). They hold 2,000 euros in liquid savings and wish to invest 1,700 euros with a 2-year investment horizon. In terms of financial background, the client has basic investment experience, limited to savings accounts, fixed-term deposits, and simple fixed-income products. Their investment approach is moderate — they rate their risk tolerance at 5 out of 10. They have stated they cannot afford to lose the full 1,700 euros invested. They have been assessed as financially vulnerable.
product_narrative: The product is a UCITS exchange-traded fund providing concentrated exposure to European technology and digitisation sector companies. The fund publishes a KID, trades intraday on regulated exchanges, uses no leverage, and holds no embedded derivatives. It is classified NON-COMPLEX under MiFID II Article 25(4)(a). Sector concentration produces higher volatility than diversified equity funds; basic financial knowledge is required. The recommended minimum holding period is five years.
